en.headline: Hang Seng Index down 182 points at midday on tech pressure
en.dek: The benchmark fell as much as 380 points before recovering to 23,571 at noon, with Baidu sliding nearly 7 percent after results.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed the morning session 182 points lower, or about 0.8 percent, at 23,571 on Tuesday.
The index had fallen as much as 380 points to a two-week low of 23,369 before trimming losses. Turnover on the main board reached nearly HK$107.9 billion in the first half.

Technology shares were under pressure, with Baidu down nearly 7 percent after reporting results and flagging a possible first dividend by year-end. Alibaba and Tencent also declined. Chipmakers bucked the trend, with Semiconductor Manufacturing International and Hua Hong Semiconductor rising nearly 9 percent or more.
Financial and property stocks were also softer.

zh.headline: 恒生指數半日跌182點 科技股受壓
zh.dek: 大市曾跌逾380點，中午報23571點，百度績後急挫近7%，晶片股逆市反彈。
body: 恒生指數周二半日收市跌182點，約0.8%，報23571點。
指數曾跌逾380點，低見23369點，創兩星期新低，其後跌幅收窄。半日主板成交額近1079億元。
科技股受壓，百度公布業績後股價急挫近7%，並預告今年底前可能宣布首次派息。阿里巴巴及騰訊亦向下。晶片股逆市反彈，中芯國際及華虹宏力升近9%或以上。
重磅金融股及本地地產股亦受壓。
